summary: E0-E2 have immutable source bindings, local and umi preflight and deterministic inputs. E3 now implements a correlated-random-field holdout, 3x2 population-resolution expansion, within-seed cross-scale aggregation, direction consistency and resolution sensitivity; its local directory and structured preflight pass. E3 server sync/input preparation is pending because the current approval service could not authorize the push. No numerical experiment has executed, and an explicit CPU-time budget remains required.

missing: numerical execution and result reconciliation after budget approval

covered: ESRI ASCII and binary grid loading
exact-histogram matched landscape generation and audit
Holm correction across the confirmatory spatial metric family
versioned E1 manifest and local/umi preflight
independent terrain force switch and scale
independent terrain production switch and scale
Release build and channel tests on umi
Holm correction across spatial metric-by-effect tests
versioned E2 manifest and local/umi preflight
shared confirmatory parameter lock and checksum enforcement
versioned E3 manifest and local structured preflight
missing: umi preflight and deterministic input preparation

blocking_findings.finding: E3 implementation and local preflight pass, but source commit 1b982db4446a5a8e33ab20eda73034ff610b8e6e and its manifest have not reached umi because the approval service disconnected twice and sandboxed network access is denied.
blocking_findings.required_action: After explicit approval is available, push main to umi, run E3 server preflight and --prepare-only, then verify the expected 240-run input matrix and both matching and parameter-lock audits.

non_blocking_assets: The engine accepts explicit initial-condition CSV files, so non-degenerate wealth perturbations can be preregistered.
The engine accepts arbitrary ASCII terrain grids, so exact matched landscapes can be generated outside the simulator.
Configuration supports fixed population by disabling reproduction and setting mortality mechanisms to zero or off.
Output directories are configurable and can be kept inside each job workspace.
Random seeds and time step are configurable.
implementation_order: Push the completed E3 implementation and manifest to umi, then run server preflight and input-only preparation.
Obtain an explicit CPU-time budget, execute E0 on umi, reconcile its result and only then authorize E1-E2.

resolved_findings.finding: Formal drift, integrated-autocorrelation-time and effective-sample-size diagnostics now generate stationarity_report.json and block E0 calibration when any run fails.
E0 has a versioned manifest bound to source commit 2dbefc41d76bcfade1261f5ad1004a51c87e50ca and passes both directory and structured preflight.
The active C++ core was built in Release mode on umi and its cycle1_channels CTest passed.

E1 and E2 have versioned manifests bound to source commit 375d5aad8cdab1ed0ee3f541382c7c7a5c414a88, pass local and umi preflight, and have 80 and 160 deterministic run inputs prepared without execution.
Parameter lock 62a906b44a063abe5aeba7450d5dc8d7c44a60bdddc082ba347131e812eeeb95 authorizes E1-E3; E1/E2 already validate its checksum and every locked field before preparation or analysis.
E3 correlated-random-field holdouts and cross-scale analysis are implemented at source commit 1b982db4446a5a8e33ab20eda73034ff610b8e6e; 116 tests and both local E3 preflight modes pass.

technical_notes: umi requires PYTHONPATH=src for module-style foundation CLI calls because the package is not installed into the system Python.
GCC 12.2 emits a non-blocking -Wrestrict warning in the inherited ic_loader.cpp implementation; it should be isolated before a release-quality build.
